text:
Mira: Heads-up: planning to publish audit-event schema v3 and a customer validation checklist this week. Need quick alignment on RBAC, KMS fields, and sample payloads. @Alex @Samir @Elaine
Alex: Quick Q: will new audit events include explicit principal_type enum? that affects RBAC parsing in SIEMs.
Samir: Yes — planning to add actor.principal_type (user, service, key). KMS integration will surface kms.key_id and kms.encryption_algo. Need to confirm PII tagging too.
Elaine: Docs + changelog: I can draft customer-facing note. Need sample payloads and migration guidance. Short example please.
Mira: Adding sample below. This is for "key_rotation" event. NOTE: we include resource.sensitive=true when storing any PII-related key metadata.
Mira: ```json
{
  "event_type": "key_rotation",
  "event_time": "2026-04-07T15:12:03Z",
  "actor": {
    "id": "svc-1234",
    "principal_type": "key",
    "display_name": "service-account-rotator"
  },
  "resource": {
    "id": "key-8f3a",
    "type": "kms_key",
    "sensitive": "true"
  },
  "action": {
    "name": "rotate_key",
    "outcome": "success"
  },
  "kms": {
    "key_id": "8f3a",
    "encryption_algo": "AES-GCM-256"
  },
  "meta": {
    "schema_version": "v3",
    "event_id": "evt-20260407-0001"
  }
}
```
Alex: SGTM. For RBAC, product teams need mapping: if actor.principal_type == 'key' treat as 'service' for role resolution. I'll add to schema doc.
Samir: Also, risk: some customers' SIEMs expect flat fields. Add flattened aliases: actor_type, kms_key_id at top-level.
schema-lint-bot: schema-lint: v3 draft validated with warnings. 4 warnings: recommend top-level flattening for backward compatibility. See https://internal.redwood/schemas/v3
Elaine: I'll include migration snippets and a short example script for customers to validate their parsers. Assigning owners: @Alex -> RBAC note, @Samir -> KMS examples, @Elaine -> changelog + customer email.
Mira: :thumbsup: timeline: draft by Tue EOD, internal review Wed, customer preview Thu. Any blockers?
Alex: Need sec review for resource.sensitive tagging. @Elaine can you add a checklist for data classification?
Samir: One more: we should document event signing and integrity headers we send when using private deployment (HMAC, x-redwood-sig). Some customers validate signatures.
Mira: Good call. Add to sample headers. Example:
Mira: ```http
POST /events HTTP/1.1
Host: events.redwood.internal
Content-Type: application/json
x-redwood-sig: sha256=abcd1234...
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Elaine: I'll add to changelog and include `x-redwood-sig` note + link to KMS docs.
Samir: For KMS, confirm if we use full KMS ARN or truncated key id in events. Prefer truncated in events and full ARN in audit logs stored internally.
Alex: Agree truncated in events. Add mapping in schema with 'kms.key_id' and 'kms.key_arn' as optional internal-only field.
Mira: OK owners updated. Quick action: @Samir can you push sample payloads to the schema repo and ping this thread when done?
Samir: On it. ETA tomorrow morning. :rocket:
deploy-bot: changelog PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/schemas/PR-1234
Elaine: Thanks. I'll draft the customer preview email and link to a 'how to validate' script. Will share draft here.
Alex: If sec team approves tagging rules, we'll schedule canary release.
Mira: Thanks team. Closing thread for now — we can reopen with updated links. :sparkles:
